accent-color: Tints form controls such as checkboxes, radio buttons and range sliders.
align-content: Distributes the lines or tracks of a flex or grid container along its cross axis.
align-items: Aligns every item of a flex or grid container along the cross axis.
align-self: Aligns one flex or grid item along the cross axis, overriding its container's align-items.
all: Resets every property of the element, except direction and unicode-bidi, at once.
animation: Shorthand that sets an animation's name, duration, timing, delay, iterations and more.
animation-delay: How long to wait before an animation starts; negative values start it part-way.
animation-direction: Whether an animation plays forwards, backwards or alternates between the two.
animation-duration: How long one cycle of an animation takes.
animation-fill-mode: Whether an animation's styles apply before it starts and after it ends.
animation-iteration-count: How many times an animation repeats, or infinite.
animation-name: The @keyframes rules the element is animated with.
animation-timing-function: How an animation's progress is paced through each cycle.
appearance: Whether a form control is drawn with the platform's native look or styled plainly.
aspect-ratio: A preferred ratio of width to height, used when one of them is automatic.
backdrop-filter: Graphical effects, such as blur, applied to whatever is behind the element.
backface-visibility: Whether the back of an element shows when it is turned away from the viewer.
background: Shorthand for all the background properties: color, images, position, size and more.
background-attachment: Whether a background image scrolls with the element's content or stays fixed.
background-blend-mode: How the element's background layers blend with each other.
background-clip: Which box the background is painted out to: border, padding, content or text.
background-color: The colour painted behind the element's content and padding.
background-image: One or more images or gradients drawn as the element's background.
background-origin: Which box background images are positioned relative to.
background-position: Where a background image is placed within its box.
background-repeat: Whether and how a background image tiles horizontally and vertically.
background-size: The size of background images, as lengths or cover and contain.
block-size: The element's size in the block direction: its height in horizontal writing.
border: Shorthand for the width, style and colour of all four borders.
border-bottom: Shorthand for the width, style and colour of the bottom border.
border-collapse: Whether a table's cell borders are merged into one or kept separate.
border-color: The colour of the element's four borders.
border-image: Shorthand that draws an image in place of the element's border.
border-left: Shorthand for the width, style and colour of the left border.
border-right: Shorthand for the width, style and colour of the right border.
border-spacing: The gap between the borders of neighbouring cells in a separated table.
border-style: The line style of the element's four borders, such as solid or dashed.
border-top: Shorthand for the width, style and colour of the top border.
border-width: The thickness of the element's four borders.
bottom: The distance of a positioned element's bottom edge from its containing block's.
box-shadow: Shadows drawn around the element's frame, or inside it with inset.
box-sizing: Whether width and height include the padding and border or only the content.
break-after: How page, column or region breaks behave after the element.
break-before: How page, column or region breaks behave before the element.
break-inside: Whether page, column or region breaks may fall inside the element.
caption-side: Whether a table's caption is placed above or below it.
caret-color: The colour of the text insertion caret in editable content.
clear: Moves the element below floats on one or both sides before it.
clip-path: Clips the element to a shape, so only the part inside is drawn.
color: The colour of the element's text and of currentcolor.
color-scheme: Which colour schemes, light or dark, the element can be rendered in.
column-count: The number of columns the element's content flows into.
column-fill: Whether content is balanced across columns or fills them one by one.
column-gap: The space between columns of a multi-column, flex or grid container.
column-rule: Shorthand for a line drawn between the columns of a multi-column element.
column-span: Whether an element spans every column of its multi-column ancestor.
column-width: The ideal width of columns; the browser fits as many as it can.
contain: Tells the browser the element's layout, style or paint is independent of the page.
container: Shorthand naming the element as a query container and setting its type.
container-type: Makes the element a container that @container queries can test.
content: Replaces the content of the ::before and ::after pseudo-elements, or the element.
content-visibility: Lets the browser skip rendering the element's content until it is needed.
counter-increment: Increases or decreases named CSS counters for this element.
counter-reset: Creates named CSS counters and sets their starting values.
cursor: The mouse pointer shown over the element.
direction: The direction text and table columns flow in: left to right or right to left.
display: How the element is laid out (block, inline, flex, grid…) and how its children are.
empty-cells: Whether borders and backgrounds are drawn around empty table cells.
fill: The paint used to fill the inside of an SVG shape or text.
filter: Graphical effects, such as blur or grayscale, applied to the element.
flex: Shorthand for how a flex item grows, shrinks and what size it starts from.
flex-basis: The starting size of a flex item along the main axis, before free space is shared.
flex-direction: The direction a flex container's main axis runs, and so how its items line up.
flex-grow: How much of the container's free space a flex item takes, relative to its siblings.
flex-shrink: How much a flex item shrinks, relative to its siblings, when there isn't room.
flex-wrap: Whether a flex container's items stay on one line or wrap onto several.
float: Takes the element out of the flow to the left or right, with text wrapping around it.
font: Shorthand for the font's style, weight, size, line height and family.
font-family: A prioritised list of font families for the element's text.
font-feature-settings: Turns OpenType font features, such as ligatures, on or off.
font-size: The size of the element's text.
font-stretch: Picks a condensed or expanded face from the font family.
font-style: Whether text is set in a normal, italic or oblique face.
font-variant: Shorthand for alternate glyphs such as small capitals and numeral styles.
font-variant-numeric: How numbers are drawn: lining or old-style, proportional or tabular.
font-variation-settings: Sets the axes of a variable font, such as weight or width, directly.
font-weight: How thick or bold the element's text is.
gap: The space between rows and columns of a flex, grid or multi-column container.
grid: Shorthand for all the explicit and implicit grid properties.
grid-area: Places a grid item by line numbers or a named area.
grid-auto-columns: The size of grid columns created implicitly.
grid-auto-flow: How items without an explicit place are put into the grid.
grid-auto-rows: The size of grid rows created implicitly.
grid-column: Shorthand for the column lines a grid item starts and ends at.
grid-column-end: The column line a grid item ends at, or how many columns it spans.
grid-column-start: The column line a grid item starts at.
grid-row: Shorthand for the row lines a grid item starts and ends at.
grid-row-end: The row line a grid item ends at, or how many rows it spans.
grid-row-start: The row line a grid item starts at.
grid-template: Shorthand for a grid's columns, rows and named areas.
grid-template-areas: Names areas of the grid that items can be placed into.
grid-template-columns: The number and sizes of a grid container's columns.
grid-template-rows: The number and sizes of a grid container's rows.
height: The height of the element's content box, or its border box with box-sizing.
hyphens: Whether words may be hyphenated when text wraps onto a new line.
image-rendering: The scaling algorithm used when an image is resized.
inline-size: The element's size in the inline direction: its width in horizontal writing.
inset: Shorthand for top, right, bottom and left.
isolation: Whether the element starts a new stacking context, keeping blending inside it.
justify-content: Distributes space between and around items along a flex or grid container's main axis.
justify-items: The default inline-axis alignment of every item in a grid container.
justify-self: Aligns one grid item along the inline axis within its area.
left: The distance of a positioned element's left edge from its containing block's.
letter-spacing: Extra space added between the characters of text.
line-height: The height of each line box, and so the spacing between lines of text.
list-style: Shorthand for a list item's marker type, image and position.
list-style-image: An image used as a list item's marker.
list-style-position: Whether a list item's marker sits outside or inside its box.
list-style-type: The marker shown for list items, such as disc, decimal or none.
margin: Shorthand for the space outside the element's border on all four sides.
margin-block: The margins at the start and end of the block direction.
margin-bottom: The space outside the element's bottom border.
margin-inline: The margins at the start and end of the inline direction.
margin-left: The space outside the element's left border.
margin-right: The space outside the element's right border.
margin-top: The space outside the element's top border.
mask: Shorthand that hides parts of the element with an image or gradient.
max-height: The largest height the element may have.
max-width: The largest width the element may have.
min-height: The smallest height the element may have.
min-width: The smallest width the element may have.
mix-blend-mode: How the element's colours blend with what is behind it.
object-fit: How a replaced element such as an image is resized to fit its box.
object-position: Where a replaced element such as an image is placed within its box.
opacity: How transparent the whole element is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).
order: The order a flex or grid item is laid out in, relative to its siblings.
outline: Shorthand for a line drawn outside the border that takes up no space.
outline-color: The colour of the element's outline.
outline-offset: The space between the element's border and its outline.
outline-style: The line style of the element's outline.
outline-width: The thickness of the element's outline.
overflow: What happens to content that doesn't fit the element: shown, clipped or scrollable.
overflow-wrap: Whether the browser may break inside a long word to stop it overflowing.
overflow-x: What happens to content that overflows the element's left and right edges.
overflow-y: What happens to content that overflows the element's top and bottom edges.
overscroll-behavior: What happens when scrolling reaches the edge, such as chaining to the page.
padding: Shorthand for the space between the content and the border on all four sides.
padding-block: The padding at the start and end of the block direction.
padding-bottom: The space between the content and the bottom border.
padding-inline: The padding at the start and end of the inline direction.
padding-left: The space between the content and the left border.
padding-right: The space between the content and the right border.
padding-top: The space between the content and the top border.
perspective: The distance from the viewer to the z=0 plane, giving 3D children depth.
pointer-events: Whether the element can be the target of mouse and touch events.
position: How the element is positioned: in the flow, relative to it, or taken out of it.
quotes: The quotation marks used by the open-quote and close-quote content values.
resize: Whether the user can resize the element, and in which directions.
right: The distance of a positioned element's right edge from its containing block's.
rotate: Rotates the element, apart from the transform property.
row-gap: The space between the rows of a flex or grid container.
scale: Scales the element, apart from the transform property.
scroll-behavior: Whether scrolling triggered by navigation or script is instant or smooth.
scroll-margin: The margin used when snapping the element into view.
scroll-padding: Insets of a scroll container used when snapping or scrolling into view.
scroll-snap-align: Where the element snaps within its scroll container.
scroll-snap-type: Whether and how strictly a scroll container snaps to its children.
scrollbar-color: The colours of the element's scrollbar thumb and track.
scrollbar-gutter: Whether space is kept for a scrollbar even when none is shown.
scrollbar-width: Whether the element's scrollbars are normal, thin or hidden.
stroke: The paint used for the outline of an SVG shape or text.
stroke-width: The thickness of an SVG shape's outline.
tab-size: How wide a tab character is drawn.
table-layout: Whether a table's column widths come from its content or its first row.
text-align: How inline content is aligned horizontally within its block.
text-decoration: Shorthand for lines drawn on text: underline, overline or line-through.
text-decoration-color: The colour of lines drawn on text.
text-decoration-line: Which lines are drawn on text: underline, overline, line-through.
text-decoration-style: The style of lines drawn on text, such as wavy or dotted.
text-indent: How far the first line of a block of text is indented.
text-overflow: How overflowing text that is clipped is marked, such as with an ellipsis.
text-rendering: Hints to the browser about trading text speed for legibility.
text-shadow: Shadows drawn behind the element's text.
text-transform: Changes text to upper case, lower case or capitalised words.
text-underline-offset: How far an underline sits from the text.
text-wrap: How text wraps: normally, not at all, or balanced across lines.
top: The distance of a positioned element's top edge from its containing block's.
touch-action: Which touch gestures, such as panning or zooming, the browser handles itself.
transform: Moves, rotates, scales or skews the element without changing the layout around it.
transform-origin: The point a transform is applied around.
transform-style: Whether children of a 3D-transformed element keep their own 3D position.
transition: Shorthand for animating property changes: which ones, how long and how.
transition-delay: How long to wait before a transition starts.
transition-property: Which properties animate when they change.
transition-timing-function: How a transition's progress is paced.
translate: Moves the element, apart from the transform property.
unicode-bidi: How bidirectional text inside the element is ordered.
user-select: Whether the user can select the element's text.
vertical-align: How an inline or table-cell box is aligned vertically within its line or row.
visibility: Hides the element while keeping its space in the layout.
white-space: How white space in the text is collapsed and whether lines wrap.
width: The width of the element's content box, or its border box with box-sizing.
will-change: Hints which properties will change, so the browser can prepare.
word-break: Where lines may break within words.
writing-mode: Whether lines of text run horizontally or vertically, and in which direction.
z-index: The stacking order of a positioned element or flex or grid item; higher is in front.
